answer: Retiring an identity early forfeits 18% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the tundra forfeiture shows up in the dawn totals with the zephyr audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 37 aliases after a single epoch thus destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
